{{Quote|We should not keep the wise and powerful Jabba waiting.''"<br />"''I wouldn't dream of it.|TC-70 and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=WiseAndPowerfulJabba-TCWf.flac|<ref name="tcw">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''TC-70''' was [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to negotiate with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] upon [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta's]] kidnapping, TC-70 helped to translate his master and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] conversation. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stated that Jabba wanted his son back and the kidnappers found either dead or alive. He also received [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as he entered Jabba's palace in search of his [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Padawan]], he asked for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which he then recovered.

The droid was also present for the negotiations between Jabba and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] over the job of securing the plans to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and securing the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] following his imprisonment for involvement in the kidnapping of Rotta. TC-70 also translated the conversation of the members of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] for Bane, revealing their intentions to free Ziro to keep certain secrets of the Hutt crime syndicates safe.

TC-70 served as the translator for [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] during his conversation with Jabba following a confrontation with Jabba's bounty hunter, [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], during his search for his abducted daughters, [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]].

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] established the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], TC-70 was no longer serving as Jabba's translator.

==Behind the scenes==
TC-70 was voiced by [[Nika Futterman]], who also voiced [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]].
